title: The Time-Space Complexity of Checking Multiple Assertions in Quantum Programs
summary: Runtime assertions are a promising mechanism for testing and debugging quantum programs. But unlike the classical world, checking a quantum program that contains multiple assertions often requires using additional space or running the program additional times. For example, on current quantum hardware where mid-circuit measurement is restricted or costly, an assertion's pass/fail outcome cannot be revealed immediately.
